about.text: A Viennese baked strudel from the Austro-Hungarian period, with a filling of soaked rolls, egg yolks, sour cream, quark and raisins. Its milk-and-egg custard topping is poured on in two parts, a third first and the rest during baking, and it is served warm with vanilla sauce.
